cohort: 436 healthy term infants from the Bern-Basel Infant Lung Development cohort
finding: Breastfeeding was associated with a reduced incidence and severity of respiratory symptoms, particularly in the first 27 weeks of life, and this protective effect was observed in girls but not boys.
mod_finding: Breastfeeding attenuated the effects of cesarean delivery on respiratory symptoms during the first 27 weeks of life.
